title: Nvidia Halts Server Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia
excerpt: Nvidia pauses server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia amid stricter U.S. export controls.
body_html:
Nvidia has instructed its manufacturing partners to temporarily halt server shipments to several Southeast Asian nations, including Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. The decision comes as the United States implements stricter measures to prevent advanced artificial intelligence chips from reaching China.

The export restrictions reflect ongoing efforts by U.S. regulators to close potential loopholes in the semiconductor supply chain. By pausing deliveries to these regional hubs, the company aims to comply with tightened federal policies governing the distribution of high-performance technology hardware internationally.
